desc: Set properties on channels in bulk.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

channel_ids.desc: An array of channel IDs on which to set the property.

property.desc: The property for this channel in a key value format. Only one property can be updated at a time

not_updated.desc: Channels that could not be updated, with reasons

errors.desc: The reasons the channel was not updated

action_already_in_progress.desc: Another bulk action request is currently in progress

invalid_arguments.desc: The property argument is not a valid JSON object representing a channel property.

internal_error.desc: Something unexpected happened, try again in a little bit. Sorry for that!

restricted_action.desc: User does not have permission to perform this action

disallowed_action.desc: This property cannot be set on this channel type.

restricted_plan_level.desc: This API is only available to Enterprise+ customers.

too_many_properties.desc: Only one channel property can be updated at a time.

property_not_allowed.desc: The property passed in is not allowed to be updated.
